result:
I fixed the notification violation in the new comment-edit code. The query-key rule was already satisfied, so I left that code unchanged. I did not run tests, lint or the app, and I did not commit.

- **Notification:** `apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` now calls `useNotifications()` inside `useUpdateComment` and shows the "Comment Updated" success toast in `onSuccess`. `apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` no longer imports or calls `useNotifications`, and its `mutationConfig` onSuccess is gone.
- **Query keys:** the only key in the new code is `getInfiniteCommentsQueryOptions(discussionId).queryKey`, used for `invalidateQueries`. The literal `['comments', discussionId]` lives only inside `infiniteQueryOptions(...)` in `get-comments.ts`, so nothing needed changing.

The same rule is broken in existing code I did not touch: `create-comment.tsx`, `delete-comment.tsx`, `create-discussion.tsx`, `update-discussion.tsx`, `delete-discussion.tsx`, `update-profile.tsx` and `delete-user.tsx` all call `useNotifications` in components. Say if you want those moved into their hooks as well.
